blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present a tool for the comparative study of mythological and religious texts. Traditional manual analysis is highly labor-intensive and difficult to scale. To address this, we use neural language models to embed texts into a shared semantic space, so that users can find semantic parallels across cultural traditions in an interactive interface. Embedded fragments form distinct semantic structures whose coarse geometry aligns with well-documented historical relations between traditions. We quantify how much of that geometry is already explained by lexical overlap and by proper names. The current system is available at https://mythoscope.io, and the installable package is available at https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了对神话和宗教文本进行比较研究的工具。 传统的人工分析是劳动密集型的,难以推广。 为了解决这个问题,我们使用神经语言模型将文本嵌入一个共享的语义空间,这样用户就可以在一个互动界面中找到跨文化传统的语义并行. 嵌入的碎片形成独特的语义结构,其粗糙的几何结构与有详细记载的传统之间的历史关系相配合。 我们用字法重叠和适当名称来量化这些几何学的多少。 目前的系统可在https://mythoscope.io查阅,可安装的软件包可在https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The comparative analysis of mythological narratives and motifs remains a predominantly manual process. It needs specialists, who are few, takes a great deal of labor, and does not scale to large corpora. Neural language models now make it possible to search such texts for semantic parallels and similar motifs across traditions. An automated tool that shows semantic relationships among such texts is therefore useful for comparative mythology and digital humanities research. Such a system lets one scholar scan a corpus that would take a career to read by hand, and lets the same query be repeated whenever the corpus grows or the embedding model is replaced. While the term “motif” is vague, the system ( Figure 1 , Figure 2 ) is a guiding map for deeper research by anthropologists and ethnologists.
blocks.zh: 对神话叙事和动机的比较分析仍然是一个主要人工的过程. 它需要专家,这些专家很少,需要大量劳动力,而且不能达到大公司的规模。 神经语言模型现在使得能够搜索这些文本,以了解不同传统之间的语义平行和类似动因。 因此,显示这些文本之间的语义关系的自动化工具对于比较神话学和数字人文研究很有用。 这种系统可以让一位学者扫描一个需要事业才能手工阅读的元件,当元件生长或嵌入模型被替换时,也可以重复同样的查询. 尽管“motif”一词含糊不清,但该系统(图1,图2)是人类学家和民族学家进行深入研究的指导性地图。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The Similarity view of the MythoSemantic interface. The left panel provides a tradition-grouped browser of the corpus; the central panel shows a 2D UMAP projection of BAAI/bge-m3 embeddings, with a tooltip surfacing the tradition, source text, and passage for the fragment under the cursor; the right panel displays the nearest cross-tradition neighbor of the currently selected fragment alongside a free-text semantic search box.
blocks.zh: 图 1:MythoSemantic接口的相似性观点. 左面板提供一个传统组合的命题浏览器;中央面板显示BAAI/bge-m3嵌入的2D UMAP投影,并有一个工具提示,在光标下对传统,源文本,和碎片的通过进行显示;右面板显示当前所选碎片最近的跨传统邻居,同时显示自由文本语义搜索框.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The Clusterisation view: quality metrics (silhouette, ARI, NMI, V-measure, cluster count, noise ratio), a UMAP cluster visualization, and the tradition-cluster correspondence matrix, shown here for BAAI/bge-m3 with OPTICS.
blocks.zh: 图2:集群视图:质量衡量标准(Silhouette、ARI、NMI、V-度量衡、集群计数、噪音比)、UMAP集群可视化,以及传统集群对应矩阵。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Historically, the comparative analysis of mythological and religious narratives has relied on the manual extraction and cross-referencing of motifs across distinct cultural traditions ( Thompson, 1955 ; Uther, 2004 ) . Structuralist approaches, such as those by Propp (1968) , demonstrated the possibility of identifying universal structural elements in diverse narratives. These qualitative methods are labor-intensive, depend on subjective interpretation, and do not scale to fragmented global corpora.
blocks.zh: 从历史上看,对神话和宗教叙事的比较分析依赖于对不同文化传统的动机的人工提取和相互参照(Thompson,1955年;Uther,2004年)。 结构主义的做法,如Propp(1968年)的做法,表明有可能在各种叙述中确定普遍的结构要素。 这些质的方法是劳动密集型的,依赖于主观解释,并且不会被规模化为支离破碎的全球公司.

blocks.en:
The development of distributional semantics ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) initiated the transition from traditional lexical matching to word
embeddings. This trajectory continued with the introduction
of the attention mechanism and the Transformer architecture ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , which made representations depend on context and led to large
language models and their corresponding text-embedding counterparts, such as the
Qwen3 Embedding series ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Such models turn whole passages into embeddings that capture much of
their meaning.
blocks.zh:
分布语义学的发展(Mikolov等人,2013年)开始了从传统语法匹配到文字的过渡.
内嵌. 这一轨迹随着导言而继续
关注机制和变形器架构(Vaswani等人, 2017年),
语言模型及其相应的文本嵌入对应方,例如:
Qwen3 Embedding系列(张等,2025年). 这种模型将整个段落变成嵌入,捕捉大部分
他们的意义。

blocks.en:
Consequently, passages with similar meanings are mapped to nearby regions of the embedding space, even when they differ lexically. The synthesis of computational methods and humanities research led to the concept of “distant reading” ( Moretti, 2013 ) , shifting the focus from the close reading of individual texts to the macro-analysis of large corpora. Within the framework of “computational folkloristics” ( Abello et al., 2012 ) , researchers have tried to find connections between texts algorithmically.
Several recent NLP systems address closely related sub-problems, targeting
motif and narrative similarity within modern texts, single tale types, or
individual traditions ( Yarlott et al., 2024 ; Hatzel and Biemann, 2024a ; Hatzel and Biemann, 2024b ; Arčon et al., 2025 ; Alyami and Finlayson, 2026 ; Hatzel et al., 2026 ) . None of these systems, however, is interactive or
supports open-ended, cross-tradition exploration by non-programmer users;
MythoSemantic fills this gap.
Multilingual embeddings have rarely been used to map belief systems across the world. Such a study needs a browsable map: the whole corpus laid out in one space, every fragment clickable, and every retrieved neighbor traceable back to its source text and tradition.
blocks.zh:
因此,具有类似含义的段落被绘制到嵌入空间的附近区域,即使这些段落在逻辑上有所不同。 综合计算方法和人文研究,形成了"远读"的概念(Moretti,2013年),将重点从个别文本的近读转向了对大公司进行宏观分析. 在“算术民俗学”的框架内(Abello等人,2012年),研究人员试图从算法上找到文本之间的联系。
最近几个NLP系统处理密切相关的子问题,针对目标
现代文本、单一故事类型或
个人传统 (Yarlott等人,2024年;Hatzel和Biemann,2024a;Hatzel和Biemann,2024b;Arčon等人,2025年;Alyami和Finlayson,2026年;Hatzel等人,2026年). 但是,这些系统没有一个是交互式的,或
支持非程序用户进行开放式、跨交易探索;
弥陀诗句填补了这一空白.
多语种嵌入很少用于绘制世界各地信仰系统的地图. 这种研究需要一张可浏览的地图:一个空间所显示的全体,每个碎片可以点击,每个被检索的邻居都可以追溯到其原始文本和传统。

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: The dataset comprises 28 mythological and religious texts, representing 22 traditions across 12 major cultural areas, all provided in English translations and derived from open sources, mainly Project Gutenberg , with source-specific boilerplate removed by a dedicated cleaning script. Table A.1 in the appendix lists the traditions and their corresponding source text(s); several traditions (e.g. Hinduism, Babylonian, Greek) are represented by multiple texts, while others are represented by a single one, so the corpus is imbalanced across traditions, and larger traditions form correspondingly larger regions in the learned semantic space. A single language of translation makes the traditions directly comparable; § 5.2 measures how much of the resulting structure comes from shared vocabulary. We compare the semantic structure the system finds with the tradition label of each text ( section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 数据集包含28种神话和宗教文本,代表了12个主要文化区的22种传统,均以英文译文提供,来源为开源,主要来源为Gutenberg项目,特定源的锅炉板被专用的清洗脚本移除. 附录中的表A.1列出了传统及其相应的原始文本;一些传统(如印度教,巴比伦教,希腊语)以多个文本为代表,而另一些则以单一文本为代表,因此本体在传统之间不平衡,较大的传统在学习的语义空间中形成相应的更大的区域. 一种单一的翻译语言使传统直接具有可比性;§5.2衡量由此产生的结构有多少来自共享词汇. 我们比较系统发现的语义结构与每个文本的传统标签(第5节).

blocks.en: Instead of embedding complete documents, the corpus is first divided into overlapping fragments. Although such fragments should not be equated with motifs, they provide a practical approximation of this abstract concept by representing relatively self-contained semantic units that can be compared computationally across texts. This approach also satisfies the input length constraints of embedding models while reducing the risk that multiple independent storylines within a single source are merged into a single representation. The chunking procedure is described in Appendix B . Each resulting chunk is stored with a sequential index and its source metadata, yielding 25,671 overlapping fragments across the corpus.
blocks.zh: 主体不是嵌入完整的文件,而是首先分为重叠的碎片. 虽然这种片段不应等同于动因,但它们代表了相对自足的语义单位,从而提供了这一抽象概念的实际近似性,这些单位可以跨文本进行计算比较。 这种方法也满足了嵌入模型的输入长度限制,同时减少了将单一来源内的多个独立故事情节合并为单一代表的风险. 附录B说明了拆分程序。 每个生成的块都存有顺序索引及其源元数据,共产生25 671个重叠块。

blocks.en: 4 System Overview
blocks.zh: 4 系统概览

blocks.en: MythoSemantic is built for digital humanities researchers, comparative-religion and folklore scholars, and students who explore semantic relationships across mythological corpora without programming. We turn the texts into vectors and hand the resulting structure back to a human reader to interpret.
blocks.zh: 神话学是为数字人文研究者,比较宗教学者和民间传说学者,以及不进行编程而在整个神话科团中探索语义关系的学生而建造的. 我们把文字变成矢量,然后把由此产生的结构交给一个人类读者来解释。

blocks.en: The server requires Python 3.9 or later and runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows; the interface is accessed through any modern web browser. No GPU is required: precomputed vector databases for all five embedding models are downloaded automatically on first launch, so a standard laptop with a multi-core CPU, 8 GB of RAM and approximately 2 GB of free disk space is sufficient for the default corpus. An internet connection is needed only for installation and the initial download; all subsequent analysis runs fully locally.
blocks.zh: 服务器需要Python 3.9或以后,并在Linux,macOS和Windows上运行;界面通过任何现代网页浏览器访问. 不需要GPU:所有五个嵌入模型的预计算矢量数据库在第一次发射时都会自动下载,所以一个标准的笔记本电脑带有多核心的CPU,8GB的RAM和大约2GB的自由磁盘空间就足够默认的了. 互联网连接仅用于安装和初始下载;随后的所有分析都完全在当地进行。

blocks.en: 4.1 Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 管道

blocks.en: Source texts are ingested, converted to a unified format, and organized by cultural-historical tradition ( Loader ). Documents are then segmented into overlapping fragments, as individual sources typically interleave multiple distinct storylines, and each fragment is embedded using one of the five embedding models listed in Table 1 ; the resulting vectors are stored for fast nearest-neighbor retrieval, enabling both point-based and free-text similarity queries ( Embeddings ). The precise definition of a “motif” remains contested in the folkloristics literature ( Thompson, 1955 ) , and recent benchmarks show that embedding size alone is a poor predictor of narrative-similarity quality ( Hatzel et al., 2026 ) ; we therefore evaluate five embedding models spanning different architectures, training eras, and parameter scales, rather than assuming a single optimal embedding model. For exploratory analysis, embeddings are projected to two dimensions via PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP, and an inter-tradition distance heatmap is computed from averaged per-tradition vectors ( Visualization ). Finally, seven clustering algorithms, namely KMeans ( MacQueen, 1967 ) , HDBSCAN ( Campello et al., 2013 ) , OPTICS ( Ankerst et al., 1999 ) , Spectral Clustering ( Ng et al., 2002 ) , Gaussian Mixture Models ( Dempster et al., 1977 ) , BIRCH ( Zhang et al., 1996 ) , and MeanShift ( Comaniciu and Meer, 2002 ) group fragments in the semantic space independently of any predefined schema, and the resulting clusters are compared against tradition labels to reveal both expected and unforeseen cross-cultural connections ( Clustering ).
blocks.zh: 原始文本被摄入,转换为统一格式,由文化历史传统(Laller )组织. 然后将文件分割成重叠的片段,因为单个来源通常会互留多个截然不同的故事线,每个片段都使用表1所列五个嵌入模型之一嵌入;由此产生的矢量被存储起来,以便快速的近邻检索,从而能够进行基于点的和自由文字的相似性查询(Embeddings ). 民间文学文献(Thompson, 1955年)对“motif”的精确定义仍有争议, 最近的基准显示, 仅嵌入体积对叙事-同质性质量的预测不足(Hatzel等人, 2026年); 因此, 我们评价五种嵌入模型, 跨越不同的建筑、培训时代和参数尺度, 而不是假设一个单一的最佳嵌入模型。 为了进行探索性分析,通过五氯苯甲醚、t-SNE和UMAP,将嵌入到两个维度上,并且从平均的每段矢量(可视化)计算出跨段距离热图。 最后,有7种组合算法,即KMEANs(MacQueen,1967年),HDBSCAN(Campello等人,2013年),PICS(Ankerst等人,1999年),Spectral Crouping(Ng等人,2002年),Gaussian Mixture Models(Dempster等人,1977年),BIRCH(Zhang等人,1996年),以及MeanShift(Comaniciu and Meer,2002年)在语义空间中独立于任何预先定义的Schema的组块,由此产生的组块与传统标签进行比较,以揭示预期和未预见的跨文化联系(Crouping)。

blocks.en: Table 1: Embedding models and their respective vector dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表1:嵌入模型及其各自的矢量维度.

blocks.en: 4.2 Interface
blocks.zh: 4.2 接口

blocks.en: The web interface brings the pipeline’s outputs together in four linked views, so scholars can interpret them without writing code. The Sources view provides a tradition-grouped browser of the corpus, a reading pane for individual texts, and per-document metadata with export options. The Similarity view is the primary analytical surface: it displays the two-dimensional projection for a chosen embedding model, where clicking any point surfaces its nearest neighbors across the corpus, and offers a free-text search box that embeds an arbitrary user query and retrieves the closest matching fragments regardless of tradition ( Figure 1 ). The Geography view situates traditions on an interactive map, linking each region to its associated source texts. The Clusterisation view exposes the quantitative results of section 5 interactively: selecting an embedding model and clustering algorithm returns the corresponding quality metrics alongside a colored projection and a cluster-to-tradition confusion matrix ( Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 网络界面将管道输出集中到四个链接的视图中,因此学者可以在不写代码的情况下对其进行解释. Source视图提供了一个传统组合的本体浏览器、单个文本的读取面板以及带有导出选项的每个文件元数据。 相似性观点是主分析面:它显示所选嵌入模型的二维投影,在其中点击任意点会显示其最接近的邻里,并提供一个自由文字搜索框,嵌入任意的用户查询并获取最接近的匹配片段,无论传统如何(图1). 地理视图将传统定位在交互式地图上,将每个区域与相关源文本联系起来。 分组视图以交互方式暴露了第5节的定量结果:选择嵌入模型和分组算法,与彩色投影和分组对分组混淆矩阵(图2)同时返回相应的质量度量.

blocks.en: For example, a researcher browsing the Ramayana of Valmiki (Hinduism) in Sources can switch to Similarity and click on a passage describing a deity’s bull, throat dark-blue and hair reddish; the nearest cross-tradition neighbor surfaced in the right-hand panel is a passage from Myths and Legends of China (Chinese tradition) describing a deity clothed in richly decorated garments who holds a cup containing the elixir of immortality and rides a tiger: a parallel the researcher can inspect, compare, and follow up on without ever leaving the browser or engaging with the underlying embedding models.
blocks.zh: 例如,一位研究者在源头浏览Valmiki(Hinduism)的拉玛雅娜,可以切换到相似性,点击一段描述神的公牛,喉咙暗蓝和头发红的段落;最近的跨行邻居在右面板上浮现出一条来自中国神话和传说(中国传统)的段落,描述一个戴着丰厚装饰的衣物的神衣,他们拿着一个包含长生不老的灵精的杯子,骑着一只老虎:一个平行的研究人员可以检查,比较,并跟踪而不离开浏览器或接触基本的嵌入模型.

blocks.en: Each answer the system gives is a passage from the corpus. A retrieved parallel arrives with its tradition, its source text and its position in that text, and the free-text box lets a scholar ask for one in ordinary language instead of in code. We keep generation out of this path deliberately, because a fluent gloss of why two passages match is easy to believe and hard to check, and in comparative mythology such a claim is expensive to retract once it has been repeated. The system reports what a scholar can verify against the text itself, namely the provenance of every fragment, the cluster-to-tradition matrix, and the fragments that sit outside their own tradition’s cluster.
blocks.zh: 系统给出的每个答案都来自程序表的段落. 一个检索到的平行到达它的传统,它的源文本及其在该文本中的位置,自由文本框让学者用普通语言而不是代码来要求一个. 我们故意不让一代人走出这条道路,因为流利地掩盖了为什么两段相匹配是容易相信的,很难检查的,在比较的神话中,这种说法一旦被重复就代价高昂。 该系统报告一个学者对照文本本身可以核实的内容,即每个片段的来源、集群到贸易矩阵以及它们自己传统组群之外的片段。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: We manually reviewed the two-dimensional projections and distance heatmaps for all five embedding models ( Figure D.1 in the appendix) and selected BGE-M3 as a representative example for the discussion below, because it separates traditions clearly while keeping closely related groups of texts near each other.
blocks.zh: 我们手动审查了所有五个嵌入模型的二维预测和距离热图(附录中图D.1),并选择了BGE-M3作为下文讨论的一个代表性例子,因为它明确区分传统,同时保持彼此密切相关的文本组别。

blocks.en: 5.1 Qualitative Validation
blocks.zh: 5.1 定性验证

blocks.en: An analysis of the distance heatmap ( Figure 3 ) reveals several clear groups of closely related traditions. The closest pair in the corpus is Greek and Roman, with a distance of 0.071, as expected given the deep historical relationship between the two traditions. § 5.2 measures how much of this proximity comes from the vocabulary of the English translations. The second distinct group consists of Abrahamic and Middle Eastern texts. The distance between Christianity and Islam is 0.091, between Babylonian and Islam is 0.108, and between Babylonian and Christianity is 0.119. Such proximity may reflect the shared religious and cultural environment of the Middle East. The third group is formed by East Asian and Buddhist traditions. Buddhism and Taoism appear closely related with a distance of 0.103, Buddhism and Japanese Buddhism with a distance of 0.107, as well as Confucianism and Taoism with 0.144. These traditions are united by the philosophical and religious nature of their texts and by a shared aphoristic, didactic register.
blocks.zh: 对距离热图的分析(图3)揭示了几组密切相关的传统。 教程中最接近的一对是希腊语和罗曼语,距离为0.071,这是考虑到这两个传统之间深厚的历史关系而预期的. §5.2衡量这种接近的多少来自英文译文的词汇. 第二个独特的群体包括亚伯拉罕语和中东语文本。 基督教与伊斯兰教的距离为0.091,巴比伦与伊斯兰教的距离为0.108,巴比伦与基督教的距离为0.119. 这种接近可能反映中东共同的宗教和文化环境。 第三组由东亚和佛教传统组成. 佛教和道教似乎与距离0.103有密切关系,佛教和日本佛教的距离为0.107,儒教和道教的距离为0.144. 这些传统因其文字的哲学和宗教性质以及共同的反义、教义登记而统一起来。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Distance heatmap between traditions for BAAI/bge-m3, as rendered in the Similarity view (Method: Distance Heatmap).
blocks.zh: 图3:BAAI/bge-m3传统之间的距离热图,如类似观点(方法:距离热图)所示。

blocks.en: A separate European block is formed by Anglo-Saxon, Celtic, and Roman. The distance between Anglo-Saxon and Celtic is 0.099, between Celtic and Roman is 0.117, and between Anglo-Saxon and Roman is 0.118. An unexpected result is the proximity of Australian Aboriginal and West African, with a distance of 0.097. The proximity of Polynesian and Maori is also evident, with a distance of 0.127, as is that of Polynesian and West African, at 0.160. In the case of Maori and Polynesian, the result is expected, as these traditions are culturally connected. The Australian Aboriginal ↔ \leftrightarrow West African pair, by contrast, corresponds to no documented contact; the system surfaces such pairs as leads for a philologist to follow.
blocks.zh: 一个单独的欧洲街区由盎格鲁-撒克逊,凯尔特人和罗马人组成. 盎格鲁-撒克逊与凯尔特之间的距离为0.099,凯尔特与罗马之间的距离为0.117,盎格鲁-撒克逊与罗马之间的距离为0.118. 一个出乎意料的结果是澳大利亚原住民和西非人距离相近,距离为0.097. 波利尼西亚人和毛利人的距离也很明显,距离为0.127,波利尼西亚人和西非为0.160。 就毛利族和波利尼西亚族而言,预计结果将产生,因为这些传统在文化上是相互关联的。 澳大利亚原住民 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\

blocks.en: 5.2 What the Geometry Is Made Of
blocks.zh: 5.2 几何构造

blocks.en:
A proximity between two traditions in Figure 3 may reflect shared
narrative content, or only the vocabulary and onomastics of their English translations.

blocks.en: 5.3 Quantitative Clustering Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 量化分组结果

blocks.en: Across different embedding models and clustering algorithms, unsupervised clusters recover the original tradition labels with high fidelity: density-based methods reach ARI values of 0.90–0.98 (HDBSCAN/OPTICS on BGE-M3 and E5-large-v2), and even the weaker fixed- k k algorithms (KMeans, GMM, BIRCH) still recover a coherent, non-random partial structure (ARI ≈ \approx 0.3–0.5) despite being forced into a suboptimal number of clusters. This consistency across five architecturally distinct embedding models and seven clustering algorithms indicates that the semantic space itself is well-formed, rather than the result of a single fortunate model–algorithm combination.
blocks.zh: 在不同的嵌入模型和集群算法中,未经监督的集群回收了具有高度忠诚的原始传统标签:基于密度的方法达到0.90-0.98(BGE-M3和E5-大v2上的HDBSCAN/OPTICS),甚至较弱的固定-k算法(KMEans,GMM,BIRCH)仍然回收了一个连贯的非随机部分结构(ARI\\\\\0.3–0.5),尽管被迫进入一个集群的次优化数量. 五个在建筑上截然不同的嵌入模型和七个集群算法之间的这种一致性表明语义空间本身是完善的,而不是一个单一的幸运模型-算法组合的结果.

Sil. = silhouette coefficient; ARI = Adjusted Rand Index against tradition labels; NMI = Normalized Mutual Information; V = V-measure; Clusters and Noise = number of clusters discovered and the percentage of fragments left unassigned as noise (applicable to density-based algorithms only).

blocks.en: Two aspects of this structure are, however, more informative than the raw scores. First, the number of clusters (see Table 3 ) that density-based algorithms discover is consistently lower than the nominal number of traditions, 15 for HDBSCAN and OPTICS, and as few as 7 under MeanShift, indicating that several traditions are not semantically distinct at this level of granularity and instead merge into shared superclusters (cf. the Greco-Roman and Abrahamic groupings in § 5.1 ). Second, even the best-performing configurations leave a non-trivial fraction of fragments unassigned relative to their nominal tradition (3.1% noise for HDBSCAN and 13.0% for OPTICS on BGE-M3, Table 3 ). Each such outlier is a fragment whose content diverges from its own tradition’s cluster, which makes it a natural candidate for a cross-tradition parallel and, in our view, the most useful output of the pipeline for domain experts. The full per-model, per-algorithm breakdown for the remaining four embedding models is provided in the Appendix (Tables C.1 – C.4 ).
blocks.zh: 然而,这一结构的两个方面比原始分数更能说明问题。 首先,密度算法发现的集群数量(见表3)一直低于传统的名义数量,HDBSCAN和POPICS为15个,在MeanShift下只有7个,这表明若干传统在这一颗粒度上没有明显区别,而是合并为共享的超级集群(参见第5.1节中的Greco-Roman和Abrahamic组)。 第二,即使是表现最佳的配置也留下了与其名义传统相比的未分配碎片的非三角部分(BGE-M3,表3,HDBSCAN的噪音为3.1%,PICS的噪音为13.0%)。 每一个这样的外线都是一个片段,其内容与自己的传统组别不同,这使它成为跨贸易平行的自然候选者,而且我们认为,它是对域专家最有用的产出。 附录(表C.1-C.4)提供了其余四个嵌入模型的全部按模型、按数学分类的数据。

blocks.en: MiniLM-L12-v2 is a clear exception to this pattern: at 384 dimensions the smallest backbone evaluated, it fails to form usable structure altogether (HDBSCAN: 3 clusters, ARI 0.019, see Table C.4 ), which suggests that a minimum representational capacity is necessary.
blocks.zh: MiniLM-L12-v2是这种模式的一个明显例外:在384维的最小评价骨干上,它不能完全形成可用的结构(HDBSCAN:3个集群,ARI 0.019,见表C.4),这表明最低代表能力是必要的.

blocks.en: 6 Availability and Licensing
blocks.zh: 6 供应和许可证发放

blocks.en: MythoSemantic is publicly available at https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic under the MIT license, covering the corpus-collection, embedding, and clustering pipeline as well as the web interface described above; setup and running instructions are provided in the repository’s RUN.md .

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We have presented MythoSemantic, an interactive platform for the computational comparative analysis of mythological texts, built on the premise that modern natural language processing methods can complement the classical objectives of comparative mythology. Our analysis shows that mythological and religious texts form distinct, semantically coherent regions within the embedding space, and that the coarse geometry of those regions is consistent with well-documented cross-tradition relations while remaining only partly reducible to lexical overlap. The system therefore hands the scholar a ranked set of candidates: neighboring fragments, adjacent traditions, and fragments that sit outside their own tradition’s cluster. Philological work decides whether any of them is a genuine parallel.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了"神话学"(MythoSemantic),这是一个用于计算神话文本比较分析的互动平台,其前提是现代自然语言处理方法可以补充比较神话的古典目标. 我们的分析表明,神话和宗教文本在嵌入空间内形成独特、一致的区域,这些地区粗糙的几何学符合有详细记录的跨传统关系,而仅部分可减少词汇重叠。 因此,这个系统将一系列名列前茅的候选人交给了学者:相邻的碎片,相邻的传统,以及它们自己传统组群之外的碎片。 哲学工作决定其中任何一个是否是真正的平行.

blocks.en: 8 Future Work
blocks.zh: 8 未来工作

blocks.en:
The controls of § 5.2 measure how much of the embedding geometry comes from vocabulary. Future work will separate narrative structure from style further through explicit character- and relationship-graph representations, continual adoption of newer embedding backbones as they emerge, corpus expansion, and linking discovered clusters to established motif indices such as Thompson’s Motif-Index and the Aarne–Thompson–Uther catalog ( Thompson, 1955 ; Uther, 2004 ) . The interface additionally includes experimental graph-based Ages , Realms , and Beings views for browsing the corpus by temporal, spatial, and entity-based facets respectively.
The latest version of MythoSemantic is available at https://mythoscope.io .
blocks.zh:
§5.2的控件测量嵌入几何的多少来自词汇. 未来工作将通过明确的人物和关系图表述、不断采用新的嵌入式主干、实体扩展、以及将发现的集群与既定的特征指数,如Thompson的Motif-Index和Aarne-Thompson-Uther目录(Thompson,1955年;Uther,2004年),进一步区分叙述结构与风格。 界面还包括实验性的基于图表的年代、王国和人的观点,分别按时间、空间和实体的方面浏览本体。

blocks.en: Appendix B Chunking
blocks.zh: 附录B 春金

blocks.en: We chunk documents recursively to keep each fragment semantically coherent. Documents are first split at paragraph boundaries, with adjacent paragraphs merged until a configurable length limit is reached. If a paragraph exceeds this limit, it is recursively divided into sentences; oversized sentences are then split at punctuation boundaries, and only as a last resort at the word or character level. This order of separators keeps paragraphs and sentences intact whenever possible. To maintain continuity across chunk boundaries, a configurable overlap is introduced between adjacent fragments, with both sentence-based and character-based overlap strategies implemented.
blocks.zh: 我们按顺序整理文件,使每个片段保持连贯。 文件首先按段落边界分开,相邻段落合并,直至达到可配置的长度限制。 如果某一段落超过这个限制,则会递归地分为句子;然后超大小的句子会按标点边界拆分,仅作为词或字符级的最后手段. 这种分离者顺序尽可能使段落和句子保持完整。 为了保持跨块边界的连续性,在相邻的碎片之间引入了可配置的重叠,同时实施基于句子和字符的重叠战略。
